description: Stage 5 of validation, against the compiled registry vendored with the package: W7090 for another registry, unknown checks, check versions, tiers, kinds and count classes, unknown statistics, messages and scope parts, missing scope parts and the optimisation status.

cases.description: A valid document whose registry hash differs from that of the registry of this release: W7090 alone, at /inputs/registry_hash.

issues.message: The registry hash at /inputs/registry_hash differs from the hash of the registry of this release, so the findings were not checked against registry entries.

cases.description: Another registry hash with findings that the registry of this release would reject: W7090 alone, since the findings are not checked against registry entries.

issues.message: The registry hash at /inputs/registry_hash differs from the hash of the registry of this release, so the findings were not checked against registry entries.

cases.description: A finding of the check 'structure.level_sizes', which the registry does not have: E7040 alone for that finding, whose version and statistics are not checked.

issues.message: The check 'structure.level_sizes' at /findings/2/check is not in the registry.

cases.description: keys.duplicates with the check version 2 and the tier T1: E7041 at each, with the value of the entry.

issues.message: The value at /findings/0/check_version must be 1, as the registry entry of the check states.
The value at /findings/0/tier must be 'T0', as the registry entry of the check states.

cases.description: The statistic rows of keys.duplicates with the kind ratio and duplicate_rows with the class non_person: E7041 at each. levels of structure.cluster_sizes, whose class is by_unit, may be either class.

issues.message: The value at /findings/0/statistics/duplicate_rows/count_class must be 'person', as the registry entry of the check states.
The value at /findings/0/statistics/rows/kind must be 'count', as the registry entry of the check states.

cases.description: A scope part 'factor' on keys.duplicates, whose scope is model, a message 'all_rows' and a statistic 'rows_total' that sample.raw_vs_analysis does not define: E7042 for each, naming its kind.

issues.message: The scope part 'factor' at /findings/0/scope/factor is not defined by the registry entry of the check.
The message 'all_rows' at /findings/1/message/id is not defined by the registry entry of the check.
The statistic 'rows_total' at /findings/1/statistics/rows_total is not defined by the registry entry of the check.

cases.description: An available finding of structure.cluster_sizes with an empty scope and a finding of structure.label_incidence that is not available with the part 'first' alone: E7043 for each missing part. A finding that is not available with an empty scope, for the whole check, has no issue.

issues.message: The scope at /findings/2/scope lacks the part 'factor'.
The scope at /findings/4/scope lacks the part 'second'.

cases.description: A model without grouping factors: outcome.minority_events, whose scope is grouping_factor_or_model, yields its finding for the model with an empty scope, which has no issue, whereas an available finding of outcome.constant_clusters with an empty scope lacks the part 'factor': E7043.

issues.message: The scope at /findings/0/scope lacks the part 'factor'.

cases.description: An optimisation status on a finding of keys.duplicates, which evaluates no fitted model: E7044.

issues.message: The status at /findings/0/status must include optimisation exactly when the check evaluates a fitted model.

cases.description: Several issues of stage 5 in three findings, sorted by pointer: E7041 and E7044 in the first, E7041 in the second and E7041 and E7042 in the third.

issues.message: The value at /findings/0/check_version must be 1, as the registry entry of the check states.
The status at /findings/0/status must include optimisation exactly when the check evaluates a fitted model.
The value at /findings/1/statistics/rows_kept/count_class must be 'person', as the registry entry of the check states.
The scope part 'unit' at /findings/2/scope/unit is not defined by the registry entry of the check.
The value at /findings/2/statistics/median/kind must be 'count', as the registry entry of the check states.

cases.description: An internal document whose quantile lower_quartile of structure.cluster_sizes writes n 5 beside the count levels of 4 that gives it: E7025 at the n, since the rule holds in every document.

issues.message: The n at /findings/2/statistics/lower_quartile/quantile/n must be left out unless the count 'levels' of its finding is written, and must then equal that count.

cases.description: A shareable document whose count levels of structure.cluster_sizes is suppressed and whose suppressed median keeps n 2, which shows the suppressed count: E7025 at the n. The other quantiles leave n out, as step 11 of privacy.md writes them.

issues.message: The n at /findings/1/statistics/median/quantile/n must be left out unless the count 'levels' of its finding is written, and must then equal that count.

cases.description: A shareable document whose count levels of structure.cluster_sizes is written as 20 and whose quantiles write n 20 beside it, the median of 20 values with its value and the others suppressed by the quantile rule: no issue.
